title: anthemis rigida f. radiata
intro: Anthemis rigida f. radiata, commonly known as Yarrow, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This flowering plant is prized for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Yarrow include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which have been traditionally used to treat wounds, relieve menstrual cramps, and calm digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Yarrow include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
